simple.summary: גֶּרֶשׁ (geresh) means produce (as if expelled) First listed occurrence: Deut 33 14.

definitions.full: H1645. geresh [ גֶּ֫רֶשׁ ] noun [masculine] thing thrust or put forth, yield ; construct יְרָחִים גֶּרֶשׁ Deut 33:14 yield, produce of moons || שָׁ֑מֶשׁ תְּבוּאֹת ; i.e. produce in its seasons, compare Di.
